provenance: Hardware facts supplied from physical tests. The animation must not invent unverified behavior.

clock.note: No finer-grained execution timing is established.

registers.r0: Reads zero in tested operand operations; writes do not change a physical register; use as a zero source only.
registers.r15: Can retain loaded data, but both operand ports currently read it incorrectly as zero; reject it.

known_defects: Conditional branch behavior and overflow semantics are unverified.
Back-to-back instructions and destination/source overlap are not fully certified.

instruction_set.name: INC
instruction_set.semantics: dest = (src + 1) & 255; source is physical B and physical A is R0.

instruction_set.name: DEC
instruction_set.semantics: Known faulty; reject and do not animate as correct.

instruction_set.name: LDI
instruction_set.semantics: Load 8-bit immediate; immediate byte is not bit-reversed.

encoding.printed_binary_order: Most-significant bit first; format each word as 16 binary digits.

safe_rom_layout.reason_for_tail: Defective fetch aliases make 60 fetch 56 and 61 fetch 57; keep the entire tail zero.
safe_rom_layout.execution: PC continues; after address 63 it wraps to 0 and repeats. Operator must stop clock externally.

demo.title: Add 165 and 60
demo.starting_pc_note: Illustrative demo assumption only; hardware reset/startup behavior was not specified.
demo.remaining_addresses: 7-63 are NOP; addresses 56-63 are explicitly reserved zeroes.
demo.timing: Each PC address is held for 146 game ticks (7.3 seconds at 20 TPS).
demo.stop_note: This sequence does not halt; the PC continues through padding and repeats after wraparound.
demo.output_note: There is no CPU output instruction or output port established by these facts; values are shown as explanatory register state.

optional_physical_rom_mapping.screen_word_orientation: Physical bit 0 is the rightmost character of a printed binary word.
optional_physical_rom_mapping.scope: Pure placement data only; no server, RCON, or live block placement.

animation_accuracy_rules: Visualize only facts in this file; make unsupported details visibly unknown or omit them.
Use a conceptual behavioral flow, not invented internal wiring or clock microsteps.
Show lhs as physical A and rhs as physical B, especially for noncommutative SUB.
Show register-nibble bit reversal; do not reverse the whole word or the LDI immediate byte.
Show one NOP gap after every instruction, address 0 as NOP, and the reserved 56-63 tail.
Do not show a HALT, usable branches, memory, stack, CALL/RET, I/O, or valid DEC.
